caption:
a client booked 9:30 pm. again. the committee accepted his saturday call and declined my appraisal.

set working hours in your work calendar (google calendar: settings > general > working hours & location) so people get a warning before they book you at night. then answer late invites with "propose a new time", not yes.

what time does your latest call start? just the time.

Comment BOSS and I'll DM you the working hours setup for google calendar and outlook, plus 3 polite replies that move a night call to the morning.
